title: Google Shopping Scraper
description: Scrape Google Shopping results for any search: product title, price, old price, currency, merchant, rating, review count, shipping, returns, image and Google product link. 46 countries, sort by price or rating, price range filter.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: What you would type into Google Shopping, one search per line, e.g. 'air fryer' or 'nike air max 90'.

countryCode.title: Country
countryCode.description: Which Google Shopping country to search. Prices come in that country's currency, from its merchants.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max products per search
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Stop after this many products for each search (1-1000). Google shows about 30-40 new products per page.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Only products at or above this price, in the country's currency. Leave empty for no limit.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Only products at or below this price, in the country's currency. Leave empty for no limit.

skipUsed.title: Skip used and refurbished
skipUsed.description: Drop products marked pre-owned, used or refurbished (not charged).

startUrls.title: Google Shopping URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Paste Google Shopping search URLs (google.com/search?...&udm=28 or tbm=shop), e.g. with filters you set in the browser. The query, country and filters are taken from the URL.

languageCode.title: Interface language
languageCode.description: Google interface language, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'pt-BR'. Empty = the country's main language. Affects labels like shipping and returns, not the products.

fillWithOtherSorts.title: Go deeper when Google runs out
fillWithOtherSorts.description: Google stops after a few pages. When you ask for more products than one sort order gives, the Actor also reads the other sort orders (price, rating) and adds the new products. Duplicates are never returned or charged.

strictPriceFilter.title: Enforce price range on results
strictPriceFilter.description: Google's price filter is a hint. With this on, products outside your min/max price are dropped (not charged).

maxResultsTotal.title: Max products in total
maxResultsTotal.description: Stop the whole run after this many products across all searches. 0 = no limit.
